summary.en: Complex generics, inhaled medicines and biosimilars dominate development. Named clinical-stage disclosure is limited, with much of the pipeline presented as product categories and launch ambitions.
summary.zh: 研发以复杂仿制药、吸入制剂和生物类似药为主。已点名的临床阶段披露有限,管线多以产品类别和上市目标的形式呈现。

ind.zh: 肿瘤;以印度为重点的临床开发
肿瘤;以印度为重点的临床开发
结核病、麻风病和布鲁里溃疡

watch.en: Tarapur, Mandideep Unit-1 and Pithampur Unit-II remain remediation sites.
watch.zh: Tarapur、Mandideep Unit-1 和 Pithampur Unit-II 仍为整改工厂。

watch.en: US and India represented 39% and 31% of Q2 FY2027 sales, respectively.
watch.zh: 美国和印度分别占 2027 财年第二季度销售额的 39% 和 31%。

watch.en: Company targets six biosimilar filings in regulated markets by 2029.
watch.zh: 公司目标是到 2029 年在受监管市场完成六项生物类似药申报。

watch.en: TB Alliance leads telacebec clinical work; Lupin supports manufacturing and regulatory activities.
watch.zh: TB Alliance 主导 telacebec 的临床工作;Lupin 支持生产和注册事务。

gaps: No complete current asset-by-phase page located; annual development review and latest quarterly presentation used. No company phase totals verified.
Numbered phases are undisclosed for nivolumab, pembrolizumab and telacebec in reviewed materials; null. Denosumab phase reflects Japan submission, not India approval status.
Origins except telacebec collaboration, asset-specific next dates and targets were not verified. Aflibercept recorded as other biologic modality.
Ranibizumab and pegfilgrastim are already approved and excluded. Generic launch projections were not used as proof of clinical phase.

Required curl -sSIL URL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17, but all returned HTTP 000 / curl error 6 (DNS resolution unavailable in this environment). Browser-observed sources underpin the entries; final HTTP status validation could not be completed.

Telacebec collaboration establishes responsibilities but does not establish discovery origin; origin is null. Annual development review covers FY2026, ending March 2026; later quarterly sources and approval announcements supersede older statuses where verified.
